sketch/types/01-flowchart.title: Flowchart
sketch/types/01-flowchart.alt: A flowchart of a key press in tuios: a mode decision sends it to the PTY inside a pane group, to the leader key, or to a window action, and every path ends in a frame

sketch/types/02-sequence.title: Sequence
sketch/types/02-sequence.alt: A sequence diagram with numbered messages: you start an agent, the daemon spawns it, and a loop with an optional approval and an alt block for allow or deny, inside two coloured boxes

sketch/types/03-state.title: State
sketch/types/03-state.alt: A state diagram of an agent: idle, a working state with nested thinking and tool states, a fork into two subagents, and waiting, done and failed

sketch/types/04-class.title: Class
sketch/types/04-class.alt: A class diagram of the agent interface, its two implementations, an enumeration, and the daemon, session, pane and host classes with their links and multiplicities

sketch/types/05-er.title: ER
sketch/types/05-er.alt: An ER diagram of hosts, users, sessions, agents, approvals, checkpoints and panes, with keys and crow's foot links

sketch/types/06-pie.title: Pie
sketch/types/06-pie.alt: A pie chart titled where a week of CI minutes goes, with eight slices and a legend

sketch/types/07-mindmap.title: Mindmap
sketch/types/07-mindmap.alt: A mindmap with tuios in the middle and branches for hosts, libraries, themes, panes and agents

sketch/types/08-gantt.title: Gantt
sketch/types/08-gantt.alt: A gantt chart for tuios 1.0 with design, build and ship sections, tasks, milestones and a date axis

sketch/types/09-xychart.title: XY chart
sketch/types/09-xychart.alt: An XY chart of idle wakeups per minute by release, with bars and a line that fall from v0.4 to v0.9

sketch/types/10-quadrant.title: Quadrant chart
sketch/types/10-quadrant.alt: A quadrant chart that sorts eight bugs by how common and how harmful they are, into fix now, plan a fix, quick win and leave it

sketch/types/11-sankey.title: Sankey
sketch/types/11-sankey.alt: A sankey diagram of where key presses go: to the shell, an agent or the leader key, and then to pane redraws, the Inbox, layout changes and copy mode

sketch/types/12-timeline.title: Timeline
sketch/types/12-timeline.alt: A timeline of a release week from Monday to Friday, in freeze, check and ship sections, with tasks under each day

sketch/types/13-journey.title: User journey
sketch/types/13-journey.alt: A user journey of a first hour with tuios, with a score face for each step and a dip while you wait for an approval

sketch/types/14-gitgraph.title: Git graph
sketch/types/14-gitgraph.alt: A git graph with main, a feature branch and a fix branch, commits, two merges and tags for two releases

sketch/types/15-kanban.title: Kanban
sketch/types/15-kanban.alt: A kanban board with to do, in progress, in review and done columns, with cards and the agents assigned to them

sketch/types/16-radar.title: Radar
sketch/types/16-radar.alt: A radar chart that compares the health of two releases on six axes, such as idle CPU, memory and docs

sketch/types/17-treemap.title: Treemap
sketch/types/17-treemap.alt: A treemap of the lines of Go in tuios, with nested boxes for the window manager, the daemon and CLI, and the libraries

sketch/types/18-venn.title: Venn
sketch/types/18-venn.alt: A Venn diagram of three sets, multiplexer, window manager and agent cockpit, with tuios where all three overlap

sketch/types/19-swimlane.title: Swimlane
sketch/types/19-swimlane.alt: A swimlane diagram with agent, CI and you lanes: the agent pushes a change, CI tests it, and you review and merge it

sketch/types/20-eventmodeling.title: Event modeling
sketch/types/20-eventmodeling.alt: An event model of an approval: UI, command and event rows from an agent pane through the Inbox to a tool that ran

sketch/types/21-block.title: Block
sketch/types/21-block.alt: A block diagram of four clients above an attach arrow, the daemon with its wire protocol, sessions, panes and agents, and the parts below it

sketch/types/22-architecture.title: Architecture
sketch/types/22-architecture.alt: An architecture diagram with a laptop group and a build server group, their services with icons, and a phone that links to the server

sketch/types/23-c4.title: C4
sketch/types/23-c4.alt: A C4 context diagram of tuios, the developer, a developer on a phone, coding agents, a Git host and other machines, with labelled links

sketch/types/24-packet.title: Packet
sketch/types/24-packet.alt: A packet diagram of a tagged tuios wire frame: length, message type, codec, request id and payload, in rows of 32 bits

sketch/types/25-requirement.title: Requirement
sketch/types/25-requirement.alt: A requirement diagram of the live upgrade requirement, three requirements it contains, and the elements that satisfy and verify them

sketch/types/26-usecase.title: Use case
sketch/types/26-usecase.alt: A use case diagram with a developer and a coding agent outside the tuios boundary, their use cases, and an include link

sketch/types/27-cynefin.title: Cynefin
sketch/types/27-cynefin.alt: A Cynefin diagram that puts kinds of work on tuios into the clear, complicated, complex and chaotic domains, with arrows between them

sketch/types/28-wardley.title: Wardley map
sketch/types/28-wardley.alt: A Wardley map of the tuios value chain from the developer down to the PTY, placed by visibility and evolution

sketch/types/29-agentflow.title: Agent flow
sketch/types/29-agentflow.alt: An agent flow from a bug report through a fixer agent with tasks, a tool and a reference document, to a review agent and a pull request

sketch/types/30-railroad.title: Railroad
sketch/types/30-railroad.alt: A railroad diagram of the agent selector grammar: terms, keys, values and the separators between them

sketch/types/31-ishikawa.title: Ishikawa
sketch/types/31-ishikawa.alt: An Ishikawa diagram of the causes of a flaky E2E test, on timing, machine, test, code and terminal branches

sketch/types/32-treeview.title: Tree view
sketch/types/32-treeview.alt: A tree view of the folders and files at the top of the tuios repository
